ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.11). Layout/search/scroll/palette iteration. Pawn rows now follow Find.ColonistBar.GetColonistsInOrder (filtered to visible free colonists) with the map's FreeColonists as fallback, so revived pawns return to their bar position. Thin scrollbars sit outside the content so the last row is not cut; mouse wheel works over names and lanes, names only scroll vertically, and a Mod Settings option auto-hides scrollbars. The palette is a 3-row, natural-priority grid with horizontal slide. A search row below it has Pawn and Work filters: Pawn filters by name, Work offers a WorkType selector plus a text filter (defName/label/labelShort) and an inverse "without this work" button; the filters combine with AND. Dragging shows an empty placeholder block at the exact drop slot, keeps the held card at the cursor, and reuses the same ghost renderer for palette drops and lane reorder. WorkType names are capitalized, cards are tighter, and a deterministic WorkTypeColorRegistry colors cards/palette (user overrides are stored for a future picker). Lane tooltips show the WorkType description, all WorkGivers, best skill and current rank with a pawn-override hook; palette tooltips show description, global WorkGivers, compressed name and context skill. Resurrection/faction changes now reapply a stored order first and never recommend over it, with clear Reapplied/Recommended logs. Simple/manual Work-tab fixes, return button, right-click max, selection, Recommend/Details, pins/scoring, hooks and save/load are kept. No profiles, schedules, equipment or multi-pawn. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
